points.title: 成长与教育
points.description: 波伏娃出生于巴黎一个资产阶级家庭，父亲是律师，母亲是虔诚的天主教徒。她在巴黎接受精英教育，先后就读于玛丽娜·巴斯德学校和亨利四世中学。这段时期她展现出非凡的智力天赋，但也面临传统社会对女性角色的限制。她与哲学家萨特在巴黎高师相遇，两人开始了一段持续五十年的思想与情感关系，这段关系深刻影响了她的人生轨迹和思想发展。
points.descriptionEn: Born into a bourgeois family in Paris, Beauvoir's father was a lawyer and her mother a devout Catholic. She received elite education in Paris, first at the Mme de Maintenon school and later at the Henri IV Lycée. During this period, she demonstrated exceptional intellectual talent but faced the constraints of traditional female roles. She met philosopher Jean-Paul Sartre at the École Normale Supérieure, beginning a relationship that would last fifty years and profoundly influence her life and thought.

points.title: 哲学探索
points.description: 波伏娃在巴黎高师学习哲学，与萨特、梅洛-庞蒂等思想家形成紧密的学术圈。她通过阅读海德格尔、胡塞尔等哲学家的著作，发展出存在主义思想框架。这一时期她开始撰写日记和早期文学作品，同时担任中学教师谋生。1943年，她辞去教职，专注于写作，并开始构思她的第一部小说《不速之客》，这标志着她从哲学向文学创作的转变。
points.descriptionEn: Beauvoir studied philosophy at the École Normale Supérieure, forming a close intellectual circle with Sartre and Merleau-Ponty. She developed an existentialist framework through reading Heidegger, Husserl, and other philosophers. During this time, she began keeping diaries and writing early literary works while working as a schoolteacher. In 1943, she resigned from teaching to focus on writing, beginning work on her first novel, 'The Guest', marking her transition from philosophy to literature.

points.title: 文学创作
points.description: 二战期间，波伏娃积极参与抵抗运动，同时开始她的文学创作生涯。1945年，她发表第一部小说《不速之客》，随后创作了《女客》(1946)和《他人的血》(1947)。1949年，她发表了最具影响力的作品《第二性》，这部著作通过对女性处境的哲学分析，挑战了传统性别观念，成为女性主义理论的奠基之作。在巴黎的咖啡馆和沙龙中，她与萨特、加缪等知识分子展开激烈的思想交锋，形成了独特的存在主义女性主义思想。
points.descriptionEn: During WWII, Beauvoir actively participated in the Resistance while beginning her literary career. In 1945, she published her first novel, 'The Guest', followed by 'The Woman Guest' (1946) and 'The Blood of Others' (1947). In 1949, she published her most influential work, 'The Second Sex', which through philosophical analysis of women's condition challenged traditional gender concepts, becoming a foundational text of feminist theory. In Parisian cafes and salons, she engaged in intense intellectual debates with Sartre, Camus, and other intellectuals, developing her unique existentialist feminist thought.

points.title: 国际影响
points.description: 《第二性》出版后，波伏娃开始在法国和国际上产生广泛影响。她开始频繁旅行，1952年访问美国，对美国女性地位进行了深入考察。1954年，她发表小说《名士风流》，获得龚古尔文学奖，进一步巩固了她的文学地位。这一时期，她与萨特的关系模式成为知识界关注的焦点，他们的'开放式关系'挑战了传统婚姻观念，成为存在主义生活方式的象征。
points.descriptionEn: After the publication of 'The Second Sex', Beauvoir began to exert wide influence in France and internationally. She started traveling extensively, visiting the US in 1952 for an in-depth study of American women's status. In 1954, she published the novel 'The Mandarins', winning the Prix Goncourt, further cementing her literary status. During this period, her relationship with Sartre became a focal point in intellectual circles, their 'open relationship' challenging traditional marriage concepts and becoming a symbol of existentialist lifestyle.

points.title: 政治参与
points.description: 1950年代后期至1960年代，波伏娃积极参与政治活动，特别是女权运动和左翼政治。她支持阿尔及利亚独立运动，反对法国殖民政策。1968年五月风暴期间，她积极参与学生运动，支持学生抗议。1970年，她签署了著名的《343宣言》，公开承认自己堕胎，为堕胎权合法化运动发声。这一时期，她继续创作多部回忆录和小说，同时与年轻作家西尔维·勒·邦建立亲密关系，拓展了她的情感世界。
points.descriptionEn: From the late 1950s through the 1960s, Beauvoir actively engaged in political activities, particularly in the feminist and leftist movements. She supported the Algerian independence movement and opposed French colonial policies. During the May 1968 events, she actively participated in student protests. In 1970, she signed the famous 'Manifesto of the 343', publicly admitting to having had an abortion, advocating for abortion rights. During this period, she continued writing memoirs and novels while forming a close relationship with younger writer Sylvie Le Bon, expanding her emotional world.

points.title: 晚年与遗产
points.description: 1970年代至1980年代，波伏娃进入创作晚期，完成了四卷本回忆录，记录了她丰富的人生历程和思想发展。1980年，萨特去世，这对她造成巨大打击，但她继续写作和社会活动。1981年，她发表《告别的仪式》，详细记录了萨特临终前的岁月。1986年4月14日，波伏娃在巴黎去世，享年77岁。她的葬礼吸引了众多知识分子和公众参加。波伏娃的思想遗产深远，她开创的存在主义女性主义理论影响了后世女权运动，她的作品被翻译成多种语言，成为世界文学和哲学的经典。
points.descriptionEn: From the 1970s to 1980s, Beauvoir entered her late creative period, completing a four-volume memoir that documented her rich life and intellectual development. In 1980, Sartre's death was a great blow to her, but she continued writing and social activities. In 1981, she published 'A Farewell to Sartre', detailing his final months. On April 14, 1986, Beauvoir died in Paris at age 77. Her funeral attracted numerous intellectuals and the public. Beauvoir's intellectual legacy is profound; her existentialist feminist theory influenced later feminist movements, and her works have been translated into many languages, becoming classics of world literature and philosophy.

supporter.zh: 波伏娃被誉为现代女权主义的先驱和奠基人，她的《第二性》彻底改变了人们对性别关系的理解。她通过哲学思考和文学创作，为女性争取平等权利提供了理论武器。波伏娃倡导女性经济独立、思想自由，挑战了传统性别角色，她的存在主义女性主义思想影响了全球女权运动。她与萨特的关系模式也体现了对传统婚姻制度的超越，为知识分子提供了新的生活方式选择。
supporter.en: Beauvoir is hailed as a pioneer and founder of modern feminism. Her 'The Second Sex' revolutionized understanding of gender relations. Through philosophical thought and literary creation, she provided theoretical weapons for women's equality. Beauvoir advocated for women's economic independence and intellectual freedom, challenging traditional gender roles. Her existentialist feminist thought influenced global feminist movements. Her relationship with Sartre also transcended traditional marriage, offering new lifestyle choices for intellectuals.

critic.zh: 批评者认为波伏娃的思想存在局限性，她的女性主义理论主要基于白人中产阶级女性的经验，忽视了种族、阶级等因素对女性处境的影响。她与萨特的'开放式关系'也被批评为特权阶层的自我放纵，而非真正的解放。此外，一些女权主义者批评她在晚年未能充分认识到女性身体差异的重要性，过于强调抽象的平等而忽视了具体的生理差异。她的个人生活选择也被认为与她倡导的女权理念存在矛盾。
critic.en: Critics argue that Beauvoir's thought has limitations. Her feminist theory primarily reflects the experiences of white, middle-class women, neglecting how race and class affect women's conditions. Her 'open relationship' with Sartre has been criticized as the self-indulgence of privileged classes rather than true liberation. Additionally, some feminists criticize her for not fully recognizing the importance of female physical differences in her later years, emphasizing abstract equality over concrete physiological differences. Her personal life choices have been seen as contradicting the feminist ideals she advocated.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，波伏娃被定义为20世纪最具影响力的知识分子之一，她的思想超越了单纯的女性主义范畴，成为现代思想史上的重要标志。她的作品被广泛研究，从文学、哲学到社会学、性别研究等多个领域。波伏娃的形象在流行文化中既被理想化为女权 icon，也被复杂化为有争议的公众人物。她的生平和思想持续引发讨论，反映了现代社会对性别、自由、责任等永恒议题的持续探索。
objective.en: In academia and popular culture, Beauvoir is defined as one of the most influential intellectuals of the 20th century. Her thought transcends mere feminism, becoming an important marker in modern intellectual history. Her works are widely studied across multiple fields including literature, philosophy, sociology, and gender studies. In popular culture, Beauvoir is both idealized as a feminist icon and complexified as a controversial public figure. Her life and thought continue to spark discussions, reflecting modern society's ongoing exploration of eternal issues like gender, freedom, and responsibility.

self.zh: 女人不是天生的，而是后天成为的。
self.en: One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman.

others.zh: 波伏娃是20世纪最伟大的头脑之一，她不仅改变了女性思考自己的方式，也改变了世界思考女性的方式。
others.en: Beauvoir was one of the greatest minds of the 20th century; she changed not only the way women think about themselves but also the way the world thinks about women.
